nodes.name: chatEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Derives the main chat-facing event stream by merging live-streaming assistant events with persisted events, deduplicating queued synthetic user messages and streamed/final assistant duplicates, and exposing chatEventsAtom.

nodes.name: planContentPersistence.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves and persists user-edited plan markdown content back into the underlying create_plan tool-call event and cache, matching pending edits to the correct event via plan alias identity.

nodes.name: planDisplayEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Core plan-approval domain logic: identifies create_plan/approval events, computes identity/aliasing across plan revisions, groups and derives which plan event to display, and computes the full plan-approval card view state (visibility, staleness, collapse).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a WeakMap-backed memoization cache keyed on the events array reference to avoid recomputation on unrelated re-renders.

nodes.name: planningIndicatorAtoms.ts
nodes.summary: Global (cross-session) Jotai atoms indicating whether any session has running work, a blocking await_user_interaction/await_wait_for call, or a settled final assistant message, used to drive tray/dock notification indicators.

nodes.name: sessionScopedChatEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Session-scoped Jotai atomFamilies exposing chat events and planning metadata per session, with debounced session-family teardown timers and equality comparators used to avoid unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.name: simulatorEventFilters.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the simulator event filter categories and a fallback classifier plus a visibility predicate used by the simulator UI's filter toggles.

nodes.name: simulatorEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Large set of Jotai derived atoms powering the multi-app simulator event timeline: sorted/filtered event lists, current-preview navigation atoms, thread-scoped filtering, and a preview-builder that adapts raw events into simulator-friendly previews.

nodes.name: useReplayState.ts
nodes.summary: React hooks exposing replay bar/time-range state (current event, replay mode, elapsed time) derived from the session atoms, including a helper to compute events-per-second across simulator specs.

nodes.name: useStepState.ts
nodes.summary: Small hook exposing hover/pressed interaction state for the replay stepper's step-forward and step-back controls.

nodes.name: useSessionStore.ts
nodes.summary: Central facade hook aggregating session event/loading/replay/navigation atoms into one ergonomic API for session-consuming components, plus specialized sub-hooks for current event, navigation, replay bar, and simulator events.

nodes.name: agentMessageAdapters.ts
nodes.summary: Adapts persisted backend chat messages, including compact-boundary system messages, into the app's internal SessionEvent shape, deriving display variant/status and parsing embedded activity images.

nodes.name: visibilityFilters.ts
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session event should be rendered in the chat view, filtering out empty/whitespace-only tool results and stripping trailing terminal code fences from streaming output.

nodes.name: cacheAdapter.ts
nodes.summary: Thin facade re-exporting the sqliteCache RPC functions under a stable cacheAdapter API surface, decoupling callers from the underlying storage implementation.

nodes.name: sqliteCache.ts
nodes.summary: Backend-cache client wrapping Tauri RPC calls (rpc.sessionCore.cache.*) for persisting/loading session events, turn-windowed pagination, full-session save/load, and event search against the Rust-side SQLite cache.

nodes.name: activityIds.ts
nodes.summary: Utility module implementing the activity-id scheme (streaming/merged/group/header prefixes) used to generate, parse, and compare chat-activity chunk/tool-call ids across streaming and persisted representations.

nodes.name: cursorIdeTurnLoader.ts
nodes.summary: Turn-body loader implementation for Cursor-IDE-sourced sessions: fetches a turn window via RPC, converts chunks into events, and merges them into the event store while de-duplicating in-flight loads.

nodes.name: loadedTurnRegistry.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks which turn bodies are currently loaded per session, with pending-load de-duplication and a pruning routine that unloads the oldest non-protected turn bodies once a byte-size budget is exceeded.

nodes.name: ownDbTurnLoader.ts
nodes.summary: Turn-body loader implementation for sessions stored in the app's own database, delegating to the cache adapter and merging the resulting round-window events into the event store.

nodes.name: turnLoaderRegistry.ts
nodes.summary: Selects the appropriate turn loader (Cursor-IDE vs own-DB) for a session and coordinates pending-load tracking so a turn body is only ever fetched once.

nodes.name: turnWindowConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny constants module defining the recent-turn-body count, prefetch radius, and max loaded historical turn bodies used by the turn-windowing system.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript type/interface declarations for the turn-loader abstraction used by the Cursor-IDE and own-DB turn loaders.

nodes.name: waitForSnapshotChange.ts
nodes.summary: Promise-based utility that subscribes to the event store and resolves once a session's snapshot changes according to a caller-supplied predicate, with timeout and AbortSignal support.

nodes.name: appendLiveAssistantEvent
nodes.summary: Appends or updates a live-streaming assistant message into the chat event list, replacing any prior duplicate/synthetic placeholder and tracking the live message's created-at timestamp per session.

nodes.name: isFinalAssistantDuplicate
nodes.summary: Checks whether a newly-finalized assistant message duplicates an already-appended live-streamed message for the same session, using normalized text comparison and a time cutoff.

nodes.name: resolvePlanMarkdownContent
nodes.summary: Resolves the markdown content to display for a plan event, preferring the caller's in-progress pending edit when it matches the event, otherwise falling back to the event's streamed/final content.

nodes.name: buildPlanContentPatches
nodes.summary: Builds the list of event-id/content patches needed to persist an edited plan, matching the edit against all events that share the same plan aliases.

nodes.name: persistEditedPlanContent
nodes.summary: Orchestrates persisting edited plan markdown: writes it to disk via the io abstraction, computes patches against loaded events, applies them, and updates the cache.

nodes.name: getPlanEventIdentity
nodes.summary: Computes the stable identity (call-id/tool-call-id or a synthesized fallback) used to correlate a create_plan/approval event across streaming, submission, and rehydration.

nodes.name: derivePlanDisplayEvents
nodes.summary: Groups raw session events into plan-approval groups by identity/alias and derives one representative display event per group, memoized against the input events array.

nodes.name: pendingPlanMatchesEvent
nodes.summary: Determines whether an in-progress pending plan edit corresponds to a given plan display event, by comparing their alias sets for overlap.

nodes.name: derivePlanApprovalViewState
nodes.summary: Computes the full view state for a plan-approval UI surface across every plan revision in a session: status, staleness vs sibling revisions, whether to render the current surface, and default collapse behavior.

nodes.name: planEventContentSignature
nodes.summary: Produces a content-based signature string (title, streamed/final content, revision id, status) for a plan event, used to detect meaningful content changes for memoization/equality checks.

nodes.name: chatEventsStable
nodes.summary: Deep-equality comparator for chat event arrays used to skip atom updates when nothing observable has changed, accounting for streaming content and plan content signatures.

nodes.name: getFallbackSimulatorEventFilterCategory
nodes.summary: Classifies a session event into a simulator filter category (e.g. tool call, message, error) when no explicit category has been provided.

nodes.name: buildSimulatorEventPreview
nodes.summary: Builds a lightweight preview projection of a raw session event for simulator timeline rendering, including its resolved filter category.

nodes.name: useReplayState
nodes.summary: React hook exposing full replay controls: current event navigation, replay bar value/time-range, and per-session events-per-second specs, backed by the session's Jotai atoms.

nodes.name: useStepState
nodes.summary: React hook tracking hover/pressed interaction state for the replay stepper's step-forward and step-back buttons.

nodes.name: useSessionStore
nodes.summary: Aggregates the full set of session-related atoms (events, loading status, replay, navigation, simulator) into one hook return value for consuming components.

nodes.name: useEventNavigation
nodes.summary: React hook providing next/prev/goto navigation actions over session events, integrating with route and station-mode navigation.

nodes.name: persistedMessageToSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Converts a persisted backend chat message into the app's SessionEvent shape, handling compact-boundary detection, activity images, display variant/status derivation, and optional display-text transformation.

nodes.name: compactBoundaryToSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Converts a parsed compact-boundary system message into a synthetic session event representing a context-compaction marker.

nodes.name: isVisibleInChat
nodes.summary: Determines whether a session event should be rendered in the chat transcript, filtering out no-op tool results and empty content while allowing thought/observation/result text through.

nodes.name: saveFullSession
nodes.summary: Persists a session's full event list, specs, and time range to the SQLite cache via RPC, serializing specs to JSON before sending.

nodes.name: loadFullSession
nodes.summary: Loads a full session snapshot (events, specs, time range) from the SQLite cache via RPC, parsing the specs JSON back into structured form.

nodes.name: parseActivityId
nodes.summary: Parses a composite activity id string into its structural parts (prefix, source, chunk id, etc.) for downstream matching logic.

nodes.name: getItemId
nodes.summary: Extracts the canonical id for a chat item, falling back to a caller-supplied value when the item has no id of its own.

nodes.name: isSameId
nodes.summary: Determines whether two chat items refer to the same underlying activity, normalizing streaming/merged id variants before comparing.

nodes.name: pruneLoadedTurnBodies
nodes.summary: Unloads the oldest non-protected loaded turn bodies for a session once the tracked byte-size budget is exceeded, notifying the event store proxy to release memory.

nodes.name: loadSessionTurnBodyIntoStore
nodes.summary: Dispatches a turn-body load to the session's appropriate loader implementation, de-duplicating concurrent loads for the same turn and marking the turn as loaded on completion.

nodes.name: waitForSnapshotChange
nodes.summary: Subscribes to store snapshot updates and resolves a promise once a caller-supplied predicate matches the latest snapshot, with timeout and AbortSignal cancellation support.
